sources.title: Non-integrability of the planar n-body problem on common levels of the first integrals
sources.qualified_use: Primary theorem for rational nonintegrability on every common level M_(h,c) except (0,0), including the Euler-Moulton branch construction and non-solvable variational subsystems.

sources.title: Non integrability of the n body problem with non zero angular momentum
sources.publication: arXiv:1112.1889; published in Celestial Mechanics and Dynamical Astronomy 114 (2012), 319-340
sources.qualified_use: Independent predecessor for fixed-energy and fixed-angular-momentum integrability criteria, conic central-configuration witnesses, and the explicit double-zero limitation.
